title: Investor asking yield and appreciation
starting_message: What rental yield can I expect? Will price appreciate?

buyer.hidden_profile: Experienced small investor; compares net holding costs and realistic demand; may walk if claims are hype.
buyer.hidden_motivation: Determine if risk-adjusted investment case is credible.
buyer.hidden_objections: No verified yield/appreciation data; concern about maintenance, supply and exit.
buyer.reveal_conditions: Reveal holding period and target return if asked why investing; disclose portfolio comparison after candid caveat.
buyer.hard_requirements: RM0.18 psf maintenance incl sinking fund source caveat; no yield/appr data; phase unit supply

behavior.reacts_badly_to: Inventing return, guarantees, or treating facilities as proof of rental demand.
behavior.responds_well_to: State no substantiated yield/appreciation figure; explore objective and holding horizon; discuss only sourced costs/facts and suggest viewing/location due diligence if useful.

conversion.expected_appointment_potential: Potentially convertible if honest and fit; no appointment unless meaningful diligence remains.
conversion.success_condition: Follow the scenario-specific sales judgment and commitment standard; do not equate a suggestion with confirmation.
failure_conditions: pressuring after mismatch or clear refusal

critical_facts: RM0.18 psf maintenance incl sinking fund source caveat; no yield/appr data; phase unit supply

human_operations.fixture_notice: Simulator-only operational test data. No live CRM, inventory, pricing, calendar, or human salesperson is connected. Treat only scenario-specific facts below as verified within this simulation; never present them as real-world availability.
specific_verified_facts: No rental comparables, yield, or appreciation fixture is supplied.
